# Air Conditioner Repair

Powered cooling relies on a compressor and a refrigerant circuit. Clean the intake filter monthly and call a qualified technician when coils freeze. Switching the unit off conserves electricity but stops active refrigeration.

These repair instructions apply only to the workshop appliance, not the living quarters. Consult the [handbook](index.md) for building routines.
